fix: Check that the file path is accessible and the process has read/write permissions. Inspect `source` for the underlying OS error.

what: File not found at the given path.
fix: Verify the path exists before calling. Use `Path::exists()` or handle this variant to prompt the user for the correct path.
Ensure the bytes are a complete, undamaged PDF. Check `byte_offset` for the failure site. Re-download or re-export the file if corrupt.

what: PDF version is newer than the supported maximum.
fix: The PDF version header exceeds what this build supports. Upgrade to a newer PDFluent release, or pre-process the file with a downgrader.

what: PDF/A validation failed against the requested profile.
fix: Inspect `violations` for specific rule identifiers. Use `OpenOptions::convert_to_pdfa()` to auto-repair, or fix the source document before validation.

what: Decryption failed — wrong password or unsupported algorithm.
fix: Supply the correct password via `OpenOptions::password()`. Check `reason` to distinguish wrong-password from unsupported-algorithm cases.
The signature in `field` failed verification. Check `reason` for details. Do not trust the document content if integrity is required.

what: Operation is not supported in WebAssembly builds.
fix: This operation (`operation`) cannot run in a WASM32 environment. Use the server-side API or guard with `#[cfg(not(target_arch = "wasm32"))]`.

what: A text-edit transaction failed (see [`crate::text_edit`] for the typed per-edit errors this message summarizes).
fix: The message carries the typed reason from the edit session. A stale or invalid match id means the document changed after the search: search again and stage against the new matches. `unsupported container` and `match spans multiple styles` mean the text cannot be edited in place -- redact and re-draw it instead. Overlapping or duplicated stages are a mistake in the caller's own batch.

what: A native dependency is required but not installed or discoverable.
fix: Install the missing native library (`dep`) following `install_hint`. Ensure the library is on `LD_LIBRARY_PATH` / `DYLD_LIBRARY_PATH`.
Raise the memory limit via `OpenOptions::strict_memory_limit()`, or process the document in smaller chunks.

what: A processing limit you configured was exceeded while loading or working on the document. The `kind` field says which one.
fix: Inspect `kind` to identify which cap fired, then raise the corresponding `ProcessingLimits` field. For untrusted input, keep limits tight and reject oversized files at the ingestion layer.

what: A page number outside the document was asked for. Pages are numbered from 1, so 0 is never valid -- it is the number a caller arriving from a 0-based API reaches for first.
fix: Pass a page number between 1 and `page_count()` inclusive. If you are porting from a 0-based API, add 1.

what: A page range the document cannot satisfy was asked for: it runs past the last page, starts at 0, or ends before it starts.
fix: Pass a range that lies inside 1..=`page_count()` and does not end before it starts. If you are porting from a 0-based API, add 1 to both ends; `0..n` becomes `1..=n`.

what: The requested operation is not supported for this document or in this build.
fix: Read the message: it names what was asked for. Either the document lacks the structure the operation needs, or the capability is not part of this build.

what: Internal safety-net. Should never fire under normal operation.
fix: This should never occur under normal operation. File a bug report at https://pdfluent.com/support including `message` and `crate_version`.
